=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Class a `gh api` call as read only when its arguments are exactly `--help` or `-h`, with nothing else: no endpoint, no other flag, and no `--`." and the issue's delivery rule: "Deliver it twin-first under Q40 / CLAUDE.md §28.C: edit `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` only. The master session copies the file into `.claude/` in a `[claude-twin-sync]` commit." Both copies must be byte-identical; CI parity requires it, and the new tests load the live copy through `GUARD_PATH`.
  Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` — must contain the same three #6668 hunks as `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` (docstring note at line 26, `_BARE_HELP_ARGS` / `_is_bare_gh_api_help` block around line 184, and the per-invocation shortcut at line 1503).
  Evidence of absence: A grep for `_BARE_HELP_ARGS` and `_is_bare_gh_api_help` matches only `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` (lines 184, 187, 189, 1503); the live `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` contains none of them. The CI log of run 38065131118 already confirms: `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` → `tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py::test_live_copies_match_their_templates` failed with `AssertionError: Live .claude/ copies differ from workflow-templates/.claude/ for: hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`, which made the aggregate `lint` check fail. The new `test_bare_help_is_a_read` / `test_help_with_other_arguments_still_asks` / `test_bare_help_piped_to_grep_gets_no_decision` / `test_hidden_bare_help_still_asks` cases in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` (lines 1119–1190) load the live copy via `GUARD_PATH = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "hooks" / "gh_api_write_guard.py"` (line 27) and `importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("gh_api_write_guard", GUARD_PATH)` (line 39); they will fail against the un-synced live copy too. Every editor summary since the first one has noted that the review sandbox refuses edits to `.claude/hooks/**`; the master-session `[claude-twin-sync]` commit is the only path that can close this gap.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
